entries.title: Kernel health check and cleanup playbook
entries.summary: Inspect every running kernel, terminate the unnecessary ones, and share a status recap with the user.
required_context: Error message shown when the kernel failed to start

actions.title: Audit current kernel activity
workitems: List every active kernel session across the workspace.
Identify kernels in a Starting/Busy state for longer than five minutes.

actions.title: Collect failure signals
workitems: Gather the latest kernel gateway logs for the affected user session.
Download Jupyter server logs that mention kernel launch failures.
Ask the user to capture the full error dialog or console output.

actions.title: Clean up stale resources
workitems: Terminate idle or orphaned kernels that belong to the same user.
Ensure the user's session does not exceed the concurrency quota.

actions.title: Validate fresh kernel creation
workitems: Attempt to start a new kernel on behalf of the user.
Confirm that the fresh kernel transitions to Idle within two minutes.

actions.title: Report final status
workitems: Share the updated kernel list and any warnings with the user.
Document remaining risks or follow-up actions.

verifications: Confirm with the user that unwanted kernels have been fully terminated.
Watch the remaining kernels for at least 10 minutes to ensure they stay in the Idle state.
Validate that a brand-new kernel can be created without errors after the cleanup.
